title: Vital tile
summary: One vital sign with its unit, when it was measured and its recent trend. Use it on the patient's home screen and in the chart summary.

demos.title: With a trend
demos.note: trend takes recent readings, oldest first, and draws them as a sparkline. trendLabel says the same thing in a sentence, for everyone and for screen readers. The reading itself is never animated.

demos.note: Everything but the label and value is optional. Without a trend the tile is just the reading and when it was taken.
